summary: A Quote subscription on the NIFTY index: the index feed gives the value, OHLC and previous close with the change worked out, and nothing an index record does not carry.

deviations.reason: The web's Fyers adapter sends data.mode its own way (the subscription mode number, or no key); the desktop sends its label (ltp, quote, full). Lead rule 2026-11-09: this follows each broker's own web adapter (lane wire's per-broker dialect switch; bk-a sets the entry in phase B).
The web's Fyers adapter stamps timestamp with int(time.time()), epoch seconds; feed timestamps are epoch milliseconds (docs/prompt/websockets-format.md), as the desktop sends them.
The web's Fyers frames carry the broker's exchange token; the desktop's frames do not. Lane wire to decide whether the carrier passes broker tokens.
The web's Fyers frames carry the mapper's data_type label; the desktop's do not (a web-internal key a client can read). Lane wire to decide.
The web's Fyers frames say whether the message was a snapshot or a live update; the desktop's do not (a web-internal key a client can read). Lane wire to decide.
The web's Fyers frames carry the subscription's mode number; the desktop's do not (a web-internal key a client can read). Lane wire to decide.
The web sends HSM's exchange feed time (exch_feed_time, epoch s) as exchange_time; the desktop's common carrier drops it.

The desktop's index frames carry the change as price_change and price_change_percent, the recorded Zerodha transcript's names, beside the Fyers names change, change_percent and percent_change (feed::dialect).
